weapon.d: Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1). If foe initiates combat or if foe's HP = 100% at start of combat, grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit during combat and reduces damage from attacks during combat and from area-of-effect Specials (excluding Røkkr area-of-effect Specials) by 40%. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

a.d: Unit can counterattack regardless of foe's range.

b.d: If unit's HP = 100% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 75% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, neutralizes effects that prevent unit's follow-up attacks and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack.

c.d: Inflicts Atk/Res-2 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-3 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
Inflicts Atk/Res-4 on foes within 2 spaces during combat.
